em-field-lab.title: Wave and Field Explorer (EM01)
em-field-lab.reproducibility: Offline 3D scalar/vector plane-field lab with spatial snapshots, fixed-probe histories, transverse directions and propagation delay. Includes Julia reference calculations, locked environments, tests and an offline project; no server-side computation.

datasets.label: Julia scalar and vector field reference samples

spectroscopic-binary.title: Spectroscopic Binary Lab
spectroscopic-binary.reproducibility: Offline 3D binary orbit with synchronized radial velocities, Doppler line profiles and trailed spectra; SB1/SB2 mass constraints and independent inclination hypotheses. Includes Julia reference calculations, locked environments, tests and an offline project; no server-side computation.

datasets.label: Julia orbital states and radial velocities

binary-star-observer.title: Binary Star Observer and Eclipse Probability
binary-star-observer.reproducibility: Offline 3D binary lab with Earth projection, synchronized two-star light curves and an isotropic eclipse-probability explorer. Includes Transits.jl reference data, locked Julia and browser environments, tests and an offline project; no server-side computation.

datasets.label: Julia binary states and reference light curves

orbital-elements.title: Orbital Elements and Kepler Propagation
orbital-elements.reproducibility: Offline 3D explorer for all six classical elements, Kepler time propagation and optional secular J2 precession. Includes Julia source and tests, 108 independent reference states, browser tests and an offline project archive; no server-side computation.

pulley-atwood-machines.title: Pulleys and Atwood Machines
pulley-atwood-machines.reproducibility: Static explorer for fixed and movable pulley constraints, mass and gravity controls, balanced and reversed cases; includes Julia source and tests, reference trajectories, and an offline project archive.

gre-uniform-circular-motion.title: GRE Uniform Circular Motion
gre-uniform-circular-motion.reproducibility: Exact browser explorer for radius, tangential speed, starting angle, inward acceleration and a second point on a disk; four Julia reference trajectories, source, tests and an offline archive.

inclined-plane.title: Motion on an Inclined Plane
inclined-plane.reproducibility: Three releases from rest: frictionless, sliding and static equilibrium. Includes force diagrams, an animated offline explorer, double integration, energy checks, source and saved data.

brachistochrone-cycloid.title: Brachistochrone Cycloid and Travel Time
brachistochrone-cycloid.reproducibility: Cycloid endpoint parameters solved by bisection with the complete iteration history saved; independent piecewise-linear travel-time estimates show convergence to the exact cycloid time. Includes three endpoint regimes, saved data, source and an offline interactive explorer.

newton-constant-acceleration.title: Constant Acceleration from Newton's Second Law
newton-constant-acceleration.reproducibility: Three constant-force trajectories checked against double integration and initial conditions. Includes a worked derivation, saved data, source and an offline explorer.

julia-oscillator.title: Damped Harmonic Motion
julia-oscillator.reproducibility: Matrix-exponential solution with independent analytic tests. The project includes its environment, source, saved results and an offline explorer.

minimum-effort-interception.title: Minimum-Effort Interception of a Moving Target
minimum-effort-interception.reproducibility: Exact local explorer for head start, target speed and trial arrival time, checked against three Julia reference trajectories. Includes source, tests, CSV and an offline project archive.

constrained-variations.title: Constrained Variations Lab
constrained-variations.reproducibility: Offline fixed-mean and normalized-mode functional families with constraint geometry, multiplier-scaled normals and first-variation densities. Checked against 574 independent Julia reference samples. Includes source, tests, environments and provenance; no server-side computation.

datasets.label: Julia functionals, constraints and first variations

isoperimetric-lab.title: Isoperimetric Geometry Lab (CV09E1)
isoperimetric-lab.reproducibility: Offline CV09E1 exercises 1, 3, 4 and 6: fixed-chord arcs, semicircles, Dido shoreline and equal-perimeter polygons. Symbolic browser geometry checked against 533 independent Julia reference samples. Includes explanatory proofs, source, environments, tests, CSV and provenance; no server-side computation.

datasets.label: Julia circular arcs and equal-perimeter geometry

gradient-lab.title: Gradient Lab
gradient-lab.reproducibility: Offline scalar surfaces, contour maps, directional derivatives and gradient steps. Symbolic browser gradients checked against 2178 independent Julia reference points. Includes source, environments, tests, CSV and provenance; no server-side computation.

datasets.label: Julia scalar fields, gradients and directional derivatives

harmonics-fourier-lab.title: Harmonics and Fourier Lab (FS01)
harmonics-fourier-lab.reproducibility: Offline harmonic circles, amplitude/phase mixer and square, triangle and sawtooth partial sums. Optional sound and WAV export; 1806 samples checked against independent Julia complex sums. Includes Julia-generated audio, source, tests, CSV and provenance; no server-side computation.

one-point-oscillation.title: Oscillation at One Point (WM01)
one-point-oscillation.reproducibility: Offline WM01 displacement, amplitude, exact distance, period, frequency and same-position/opposite-direction comparisons. Three prescribed shapes checked against 3612 Julia samples and 12 crossing cases. Includes explanations, source, environments, tests, CSV and provenance; no server-side computation.

oscillation-lab.title: Oscillation Lab
oscillation-lab.reproducibility: Offline free, damped and driven spring-mass lab. Matrix-exponential motion and energy balances checked against nine independent Julia reference cases. Includes source, environments, tests and CSV; no server-side computation.

datasets.label: Julia oscillator trajectories and energy balances

orbital-gravitation.title: Orbital Motion from Universal Gravitation
orbital-gravitation.reproducibility: Planar two-body Earth-orbit trajectories computed with velocity-Verlet. Includes 37 saved launch speeds, reference CSVs, source, tests, provenance and an offline explorer with no server-side computation.
